    All Packages

    Package Summary
    Package
    Description
    io.github.jabrena.juno
    Juno's top-level compiler entry points: the CLI, the embeddable compiler API, and the small value types that connect them.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.analysis
    Control-flow structure and conservative resource/runtime-risk analysis over decoded bytecode.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.annotations
    Compile-time-only annotations an entry-point class uses to configure Juno's compilation, read directly from the class file rather than at runtime.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api
    The Java-facing hardware API that Juno's compiler recognizes as intrinsics.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io
    General-purpose digital/analog I/O: Gpio, the raw pin-number operations (pinMode/digitalWrite/digitalRead/ analogRead/analogWrite/toggle), and DigitalOutput, a zero-cost handle bound to one output pin (high/low/toggle/isHigh) for callers that prefer an object-shaped API over passing a pin number to every call.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.hid
    USB HID mouse control: Mouse, backed by the Arduino Mouse library.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.net
    A small, allocation-free Internet stack for the Arduino UNO R4 WiFi, backed by the Arduino WiFiS3 library: Wifi to connect, HttpClient/HttpsClient to send HTTP(S) GET/POST/ DELETE/PATCH/QUERY requests into a caller-owned byte[] response buffer, HttpResponse as an immutable snapshot of one such response's status and buffer lengths, and Json to read typed values directly out of a response buffer without building a parsed document.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.usb
    USB serial output: Serial and its BaudRate constants.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.lcd
    Drivers for character LCD shields, currently LcdKeypadShield: a 16x2 HD44780-compatible display in 4-bit mode plus 5 buttons read from a single resistor-ladder analog pin, wired for the shield's standard pinout.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.api.led
    The UNO R4 WiFi's built-in 12x8 LED matrix: LedMatrix, the raw compiler-intrinsic begin/loadFrame/clear operations, and LedCanvas, a boolean[HEIGHT][WIDTH] pixel buffer with shape and text drawing helpers that render into it and send it to the hardware with show.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.backend
    Code generation: turns optimized Juno IR into a complete Arduino sketch for the Cortex-M4 (RA4M1) UNO R4.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.board
    Juno's model of a compilation target: Board, resolved from the entry-point class's @Board annotation (see Board) via Board.fromApiClassName(String), or Board.DEFAULT when the entry point carries none.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.bytecode
    Decodes the intentionally small JVM bytecode subset Juno v0.1 supports.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.classfile
    Reads standard JVM class files and resolves their constant-pool references, independent of Juno's own bytecode subset or IR.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.intrinsic
    The closed catalog of hardware operations Juno understands, independent of any particular Java method signature or Arduino-side lowering.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.ir
    Juno's own intermediate representation: a non-SSA, block-structured form that lowering produces from JVM bytecode, optimize transforms, and backend consumes to generate assembly.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.linker
    Closed-world reachability: starting at main, follows every statically resolvable call, resolves hardware intrinsics and record accessors, and rejects anything reachable that falls outside Juno's supported subset — before any code generation is attempted.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.lowering
    Lowers linked, reachable JVM bytecode into Juno's IR.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.maven
    The Maven integration for Juno: goals that generate a sketch, verify and flash it with Arduino CLI, and open its serial monitor.
    io.github.jabrena.juno.optimize
    IR-to-IR optimization passes run between lowering and the backend.
